dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: EU-funded Aggressotype and MATRICS consortia; multicenter cohort across nine sites in Europe
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Participants in the current study were part of the EU-funded Aggressotype and MATRICS projects... anatomical scans were acquired in n = 248 (154 cases, 94 controls) across nine sites in Europe."

answer.Aggressotype and MATRICS: reference cohort for normative modeling (functional and structural); includes DBD cases and controls

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Normative models trained on whole cohort (TD + DBD) due to small sample; functional model n=129, structural model n=127
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "A model of brain development as a function of age and sex was created by training a Gaussian process regression (GPR) model... on a sample of n = 129 and n = 127 (77 cases, Table 1, online Supplementary Fig. S3 for an age distribution) to predict brain function and structure, respectively... Here, we used the whole cohort (both TD and DBD) as a reference."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Holz2023.pdf.md: Constructing normative models of brain structure and function

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Functional model controls explicitly reported (n=52); structural model controls inferred from total n=127 with 77 cases
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "Table 1. Sample characteristics" ... "Control ( n = 52)" ... "A model of brain development... on a sample of n = 129 and n = 127 (77 cases, Table 1...) to predict brain function and structure, respectively."
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Holz2023.pdf.md: Table 1; Constructing normative models of brain structure and function

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Control age statistics reported only for the control group (n=52) in Table 1; no separate age stats reported for structural model controls

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Control male counts reported (34, 65.4%); female counts inferred from total controls n=52. No separate sex stats reported for structural model controls
